item.title: Israel signals readiness for another Iran strike as Trump declares ceasefire over
item.description: Israel’s leaders are publicly signaling that their country is prepared to strike Iran for a third time, while a U.S. official tells Fox News Digital that Washington remains closely coordinated with Jerusalem.

item.title: Netanyahu's Israel grapples with Trump-Iran deal as details remain unclear
item.description: Defense Minister Katz says IDF will remain in Lebanon security zones as Israeli leaders debate Trump-Iran deal's impact on national security interests.

item.title: Israel fears Trump weary of ‘highly suspicious’ Netanyahu and could 'flip' amid Iran deal: analyst
item.description: An analyst says fears are growing in Jerusalem that President Trump could flip on Netanyahu amid U.S.-Iran deal tensions, with strikes in Beirut complicating talks.

item.title: IDF announces elimination of Hezbollah commander behind murder of 5 American soldiers
item.description: Israel eliminates senior Hezbollah commander Ali Musa Daqduq, accused of orchestrating the 2007 kidnapping and murder of five American soldiers.

item.title: Iran’s regime spins nuclear and Strait of Hormuz deal with Trump as victory over US, Israel
item.description: Trump announces U.S.-Iran MOU to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and address Iran's nuclear program while Iranian media claims victory over Washington.

item.title: Khamenei's 'target-rich' funeral is Iran’s biggest security gamble, sends message to US: expert
item.description: Iran's July funeral for Khamenei is a high-stakes bet that any peace deal with the U.S. will hold, creating a target-rich event, expert warns.

item.title: UNRWA fires 70 Gaza staffers amid allegations of Hamas ties, says terminations not admission of guilt
item.description: The UNRWA fired 70 Gaza staff members amid long-standing Israeli claims the agency collaborates with Hamas, though it says dismissals are not an admission.

item.title: Mike Huckabee rejects Ro Khanna's Israel visit claims: 'Not held at gunpoint'
item.description: Ro Khanna claims violent Israeli settlers detained his delegation for 75 minutes in the West Bank, and U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee angrily fired back.

item.title: Zelenskyy congratulates Trump on turning 80 in birthday call, vows more Ukraine peace talks at G7 on Tuesday
item.description: Zelenskyy congratulated Trump on turning 80 and discussed peace efforts in a phone call ahead of the G7 Summit, where the two leaders agreed to meet.

item.title: Mexican authorities discover body in trunk near Iranian soccer team's World Cup training grounds: report
item.description: Mexican authorities found a decomposing corpse with signs of violence near Tijuana's Caliente Stadium, where Iran's team trains for the World Cup.
